description: Check dependencies for known vulnerabilities before installing or shipping: up to 20 packages (npm, PyPI, Go, Maven, crates.io, RubyGems, NuGet, Packagist and more, by name and version or purl) against the OSV.dev database. Returns each advisory with CVE IDs, severity and CVSS score, fixed versions, the smallest safe upgrade, and links. Not charged for invalid input or if OSV.dev can't be reached. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

name.description: For a single package: its name.

purl.description: Or a package URL, e.g. pkg:npm/lodash@4.17.15.

version.description: For a single package: one exact version (no ranges).
